purpose: Progressive read-only analytics frontend for actual GitHub Actions snapshot publications. The default shell is empty; no Pages deployment or browser execution control.

design.audience: Clinical research reviewers checking fixed public data, evaluation intent and reproducible inference.
design.reference_observation: Narrow left navigation, four compact KPIs, a large analysis plot beside a smaller plot, and a full-width evidence table.

typography.family: Segoe UI, Malgun Gothic, system sans-serif
typography.rationale: Use the installed Windows clinical-workstation typefaces; no font network calls.

layout.mobile: off-canvas navigation, two-column KPI strip, single-column plots, internally scrolling tables

rejected: Purple/orange reference palette: client requires strictly neutral colors.
Decorative circular progress and identical rounded metric cards: no measured progress exists.
Architecture step-card layout: this is an analytics workspace.
Oversized hero and excessive explanatory prose: charts and evidence should dominate.
brief_review.chosen: A single compact KPI strip and restrained plot/table surfaces; black selected navigation and patterned monochrome data marks.
brief_review.motion: No unsolicited animation; support reduced motion.
brief_review.source_separation: PR1 data/plan is distinct from Local smoke and any later remote inference snapshot.

tabler.delivery: Small attributed CSS adaptation of pinned official SCSS and documented markup; no Tabler JavaScript or ApexCharts.

data_policy.delivery: An empty local JavaScript envelope supports direct file URLs. An explicitly configured public repository enables unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com JSON reads.
data_policy.initial_data: Empty schema-1 shell; no repository, Issue, scalar metrics, local smoke or chart measurements.
data_policy.private_or_unconfigured: No browser network request; retain the included offline snapshot.
data_policy.network_error: Visible error/stale notice; preserve the last validated snapshot.
data_policy.not_published_404: Explicit awaiting state; no fake values.
data_policy.case_update: Replace the entire snapshot. A new Issue resets view filters/source selection and cannot inherit earlier evaluation or PR2.
data_policy.evaluation_view: Shows actual computed metrics using the same metricTable helper as Result.

critique.observation: Reference is a KPI/chart/table workspace, not a sequence of explanatory cards.
critique.action: Kept a 4-KPI strip, 8:4 desktop plots and full-width evidence tables; omitted fake rings, orange/purple and export/run theater.

critique.observation: First screenshots had an unnecessary heading-focus frame.
critique.action: Removed heading-only focus decoration; retained black visible focus for interactive controls and a functional skip link.

critique.observation: Mobile diagnostic text wrapped too tightly; tablet plots became narrow.
critique.action: Minimum evidence-cell widths create internal table scrolling, and tablet plots switch to one column.

critique.observation: Initial chart/header spacing pushed all table rows below the desktop fold.
critique.action: Reduced chart/header spacing without shrinking KPI or body type; the first evidence table begins in the desktop fold.

critique.observation: Keyboard navigation could preserve a prior document scroll offset.
critique.action: Stage navigation now returns to the top; screenshot capture starts at document top.

critique.observation: Windows ClearType can add chromatic glyph fringes despite neutral CSS.
critique.action: Screenshot verification disables LCD text rendering and checks original RGB pixels as well as visible CSS/SVG colors.

critique.observation: Previously embedded example results made an initial page appear already evaluated.
critique.action: Production defaults to an empty shell. Only actual published stages fill it; Local smoke is neither embedded nor an automatic fallback.

validation.scope: Frontend regression with mocked raw delivery and actual backend-exported aggregate fixtures; not live workflow execution.
